notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped directed-interaction immediate-source-resignation surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies accepted timestamped directed-interaction delivery after the producing federate resigns immediately, while preserving standard ordering, ownership of lifecycle, callback, and cleanup behavior, without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: virtual MessageRetractionHandle sendDirectedInteraction( InteractionClassHandle const & interactionClass, ObjectInstanceHandle const & objectInstance, ParameterHandleValueMap const & parameterValues, VariableLengthData const & userSuppliedTag, LogicalTime const & time) = 0
